member.name: T:ReadyM.Relay.Server.Sdk.Ecs.ModComponentManager
member.summary:
CoreCLR-side owner of plugin component type registrations and all per-archetype heaps.
Lifecycle: one instance per ECS world. Call RegisterComponent<T> for each plugin component type during initialization, pass the returned PluginComponentRegistration to the AOT side, then dispose when the world shuts down.
The AOT side calls AllocHeap each time a new archetype needs a heap - no coordination needed from the plugin after registration. All allocated heaps are tracked here and disposed in bulk on shutdown.
